facts.label: Note
facts.value: 日下 j99:29a '長春園東北有鑲白旗護軍大營房'. 八旗通志 says '坐落水礳' (水磨: 长春园 itself was 'old 水磨村', j83:1a): the broader place. Point is 600 m E of 长春园's NE corner: fits.
